development_record.interpretation: The two executed draft cuts passed all 16 checks without behavioral/construction failure. Draft and formal outcomes are distinct recorded runs; only the formal denominator is reported as the frozen result. Static checks are not runtime experimental cases.

omissions: Full repeated normalized control/recovered states and their journal/receipt histories remain in the exact raw comparison files; this archive retains checks, field normalization policy, revisions, inventories, public results, actual observation returns and effect summaries.
Full XLSX byte contents are preserved in raw world directories and identified here by SHA256 and byte count, including the quarantined staged version.

Wall-clock durations and diagnostic state_digests were the only formal-experiment state normalizations. Identities, business fields, releases, shares, adoption declarations, and file hashes were not normalized.

interpretation.result: Two actual child processes exited 73 at the declared cuts; both recovered to the uninterrupted control, with 16/16 separate recovery checks. No retries changed formal state or bytes.
interpretation.revisions: The common checkpoint is revision 7. XLSX after_apply cut retains revision 7 before recovery and reaches 8 after retry. Publication after_command_commit cut is already revision 8 and remains 8 on retry.
interpretation.boundary: Single-world single-writer local atomic-state process-interruption recovery for two new capabilities. No power loss, machine loss, distributed transaction or arbitrary plugin guarantee. These two cases are separate from N4 worker scenarios.
